scope: Same native system-font directory and default load settings, before/current temporary copies. Per scan trial five fresh catalogs; cached lookup trial five batches of1000 queries after catalog warmup; load trial five fresh default Fonts plus independently verified A/Chinese/snowman/emoji glyph fingerprint after timing. Scan/catalog ordering normalized for content fingerprint only; query total is sum of measured API intervals, excludes signature checks. Two warmups/cohort/mode then five alternating pairs. macOS time -lp reports entire test-process CPU (0.01s resolution) and high-water RSS including harness, verification and drops; those are not API-only or steady-state metrics. No runtime child process/library added. Source font files/environment are local, not vendored or immutable; this is not cold disk, GUI/input-to-display, other-platform, long-run or complete RSS/adoption evidence.
